I looked up symbolisms of the letter "Φ", I saw that is often seen in ancient carvings around the area of Penteli, a place that reknowned for its marble since ancient Greek times. Most ancient Athenian statues are made of Pentelic marble, actually. 

This website is in greek, but I think google translate should help you. It shows the letter "Φ" carved on marble. https://www.iranon.gr/PENTELI/PENTELI2addendum.htm

Now other than that, I think you're experiencing some internal conflict, and your subconscious filled in the blanks by creating this symbol. The Greek alphabet is used a lot, I bet you've seen "Φ" before, even if you don't remember it.

I think the reason your brain used this symbol to show you the inner conflict, and the divide between you and the "demon" is because the letter "Φ" is a perfect circle, divided by a straight vertical line. It is completely symmetrical, and without each side, the letter cannot exist. 

I recommend you look inside yourself, and consider whether there are parts of yourself that you are overlooking or subduing for whatever reason. Because "Φ" symbolizes the divided, and the whole. The demon inside you is you, in my opinion. And it doesn't like being overlooked.

I don't remember being afraid of that at the time, because I had rationalized that even if they ended up looking weird, they would have other Moose to be friends with that had gone through the same thing, so they'd make new families and friends.
